cards.card_text: Here's what they will say: "The bricks have fallen, but we will rebuild with finished stone; the sycamores have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars." Friend, that's my oven catching fire and me going, 'PERFECT.
cards.verse_text: With pride and arrogance of heart they will say: “The bricks have fallen, but we will rebuild with finished stone; the sycamores have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars.”
cards.snippet: …“The bricks have fallen, but we will rebuild with finished stone; the sycamores have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars.”

cards.card_text: He runs on ahead and climbs a sycamore tree, since Jesus is about to pass that way.
cards.verse_text: So he ran on ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see Him, since Jesus was about to pass that way.
cards.snippet: So he ran on ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see Him, since Jesus was about to pass that way.
